headline: Foreclosure notice filed — trustee sale scheduled
detail: Substitute trustee's sale posted for the first Tuesday of next month against a 48-year owner-occupied homestead in Convict Hill; a lis pendens was recorded against the deed of trust this week.

headline: Owned 15+ years, now absentee (+35)
detail: Deed shows 49 years of owner-occupancy; the 2025 mailing address now routes to a Georgetown property-management firm.

headline: Homestead exemption dropped after 11 years (+25)
detail: Homestead exemption was not renewed for the 2025 roll after 11 years on file; the owner mailing address is unchanged.

headline: Out-of-state mailing address added — owner now absentee
detail: Mailing address changed to a Scottsdale, AZ PO box; the homestead flag still shows, but the out-of-state penalty and absentee signal now both apply, lifting the parcel into the A band.
